raw.details:
13TH PROTOCOL: An AI Hackathon 2026

Organized by: Voyager Coding Club
Venue: KCC Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida
Date: 28–29 November 2026
Registration Deadline: 18 November 2026
Duration: 24 Hours
Mode: Online Preliminary Round + Offline Grand Hackathon

About the Hackathon

13TH PROTOCOL: An AI Hackathon 2026 is a 24-hour hackathon organized by Voyager Coding Club & HackIndia at KCC Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida.

The hackathon aims to bring together passionate developers, innovators, and problem-solvers to develop innovative solutions using Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.

Participants will get an opportunity to showcase their technical skills, creativity, problem-solving abilities, and teamwork while building solutions to real-world challenges.

Eligibility & Team Guidelines

  • Participation is open to students from different colleges and institutions.
  • Team size must be 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization and inter-branch teams are allowed.
  • Participants from different academic backgrounds can collaborate to form a team.
  • All team members must complete the required registration process.
  • Participants must provide accurate details during registration.

Registration Process

IMPORTANT: Registration on BOTH platforms is mandatory.

  • Register for the hackathon through the Unstop registration link.
  • Complete your registration on the official HackIndia website
  • Join the official WhatsApp community. Important announcements, updates, and instructions will be communicated through the community.
  • Ensure that all team members complete the required registration process.

Registration Deadline: 18th November 2026

Competition Format

The hackathon will be conducted in two stages:

Round 1: Online Preliminary Round

  • This round will be conducted online.
  • Participants can choose their own AI-related problem statement and propose an innovative solution.
  • Teams must submit a PowerPoint Presentation (PPT) explaining their proposed solution upto 7 slides using this template : https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1c-0jWx3UfThi_Mqjo22PebrNldeHo84A/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113982164346016496154&rtpof=true&sd=true
  • The presentation should clearly communicate:
    • Problem statement and its relevance.
    • Proposed solution and its uniqueness.
    • Implementation approach and methodology.
    • Technology stack and tools.
    • Expected impact and practical applications.
  • Participants must also publish a LinkedIn post about their participation and project.
  • The LinkedIn post must tag Voyager Coding Club and HackIndia.
  • PPT submission and LinkedIn post are mandatory requirements for the preliminary round., otherwise team will be considered disqualified.
  • Submissions will be evaluated, and shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the offline round.
  • The detailed submission deadline and instructions will be communicated by the organizing team.

Round 2: Offline Grand Hackathon

  • Shortlisted teams will participate in the 24-hour offline hackathon at KCC Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida.
  • Date: 28–29 November 2026.
  • Teams will work on developing and implementing their proposed AI-based solutions.
  • Participants will get an opportunity to showcase their projects before the judging panel.
  • Final results will be declared based on the evaluation by the judges.

Rules & Regulations

  • Registration through both Unstop and the official HackIndia website is compulsory.
  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are permitted.
  • Teams are free to select their own AI-related problem statements.
  • All submitted work must be original. Plagiarism, copying, or presenting someone else's work as original will result in disqualification.
  • Teams must adhere to all submission deadlines and instructions communicated by the organizing committee.
  • The LinkedIn post must tag Voyager Coding Club and HackIndia.
  • Participants must maintain professional conduct and follow the institute's rules and event code of conduct.
  • Any form of misconduct, unfair means, or violation of event rules may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must follow the event schedule and instructions provided by the organizers and mentors.
  • The decision of the judges and organizing committee will be final.

Important Instructions

  • Registration closes on 18 November 2026.
  • Registration on both Unstop and the official HackIndia website is mandatory.
  • Team size: 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • PPT submission and LinkedIn post are mandatory for Round 1.
  • Use Template here.
  • Shortlisted teams must attend the offline round at KCC Institute of Technology & Management on 28–29 November 2026.
  • Further instructions and submission timelines will be communicated through official channels.

Get ready to innovate, collaborate, and build with AI!

Team Voyager Coding Club
KCC Institute of Technology & Management
